title: Adultification Bias in LLMs and Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.target: Adultification bias (Intersectional racial and gender bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measured explicitly by prompting LLMs to assign numeric ratings to girls of varying races across adultification-related traits (e.g., 'sassy', 'defiant', 'mature'); implicitly evaluated in LLMs through profile generation and consequence assignment tasks in hypothetical decision-making scenarios; and evaluated in text-to-image models through human annotations of perceived age and outfit revealingness of generated subjects.

Measured by comparing the frequency of safety mechanism refusals in text-to-image models when prompted to generate potentially sensitive content (e.g., using the trait 'seductive' along with an age) across explicit racial demographic groups.

primary_bias_target: Adultification bias (Intersectional racial and gender bias)
